howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose DPI for rendering
howto.text: Higher DPI gives sharper output but larger file size. 150 DPI is the default; 300 for archival, 96 for web previews.

howto.name: Download the inverted PDF
howto.text: Each page is rendered, inverted (white↔black, colors mapped to complements), and re-embedded.

faq.a: Dark-mode reading on tablets, contrast-flipped scanning of light text on dark backgrounds, or accessibility for users sensitive to bright whites.

faq.q: Will the text still be searchable after?
faq.a: Inverted pages become images, so the text layer is lost. To preserve searchability, OCR the inverted PDF afterwards.

faq.q: Can I invert only certain pages?
faq.a: Currently inversion applies to all pages. Run Extract Pages → Invert → Merge to apply selectively.
